label: TSMM to Verifiable Trust Communities binding
description: Maps Verifiable Trust Communities (VTC) extension concepts into TSMM abstractions so community-governed trust structures can be indexed and compared consistently.

mappings.description: Community-bounded trust domain governed by explicit participation and policy expectations.
Authority defining participation conditions, review rules, and remediation expectations.
Registry-like publication and lookup surface for community state and member status.
Credential or attestable artifact expressing community membership or standing.
Downstream consumer that depends on community trust state to produce effects.

notes: The VTC extension is modeled as a specialized trust domain with additional governance and membership semantics.
This binding makes the extension publishable in the same registry vocabulary as core TSMM graphs and external ecosystem bindings.

guarantees.name: community-governance-modeling
guarantees.description: Community governance, membership, and standing can be modeled through TSMM trust domain and credential abstractions.

guarantees.name: membership-state-comparison
guarantees.description: Community status transitions can be compared with TSMM lifecycle and trust-state concepts.

guarantees.name: registry-parity
guarantees.description: Community registries can be represented as registry-like objects, but operational member management remains extension-specific.

limitations.name: community-specific sanctions
limitations.impact: TSMM does not prescribe sanction logic or remediation procedures for every community.
limitations.mitigation: Preserve community-specific governance text alongside TSMM publication artifacts.

behavioralExpectations.expectation: Membership credentials are interpreted with standing, sanction, and remediation context intact.
Cross-community recognition remains explicit and revocable in the mapped TSMM graph.
